planets.name: WASP-145 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-145 A with a 1.77-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: WASP-145 A b was found in 2018 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-145 A. Its orbit and size follow Hellier et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
